title: Kazene Trace Record v0.1
description: A trace record for documenting structural fingerprints, provenance signals, and evidence metadata for AI-era creative works. This schema does not prove legal ownership or enforce royalties.

trace_id.description: A unique identifier for this trace record.

spec_version.description: The version of the Trace Protocol used by this record.

created_at.description: The timestamp when this trace record was created.

source.description: Information about the original work or source being traced.

creator.description: The creator, author, or entity associated with the source work.

creator_id.description: Optional creator identifier, handle, DID, ORCID, GitHub account, or platform-specific ID.

work_title.description: The title of the source work.

canonical_url.description: The canonical URL of the source work.

published_at.description: The publication timestamp of the source work.

platform.description: The primary platform where the source work was published.

language.description: The language of the source work, preferably as a BCP 47 language tag.

fingerprint.description: Reference to the structural fingerprint associated with the source work.

fingerprint_id.description: Identifier of the related Structure Fingerprint record.

method.description: The method or specification used to generate the structural fingerprint.

hash.description: A cryptographic hash of the canonicalized structure or fingerprint object.

canonicalization.description: The canonicalization method used before hashing or fingerprint generation.

fingerprint_uri.description: Optional URI pointing to the full Structure Fingerprint record.

trace_context.description: Contextual information about where and how the trace may be observed.

platforms.description: Platforms where the work, its traces, or related implementations appear.

related_protocols.description: Related protocols, specifications, or systems that may consume or refer to this trace record.

implementation_refs.description: Optional references to implementations, repositories, Custom GPTs, or prototype systems related to this trace.

evidence.description: Evidence signals associated with this trace record. These signals support later review but do not constitute legal proof by themselves.

timestamp_evidence.description: Whether publication or creation timestamp evidence exists.

repository_evidence.description: Whether repository-based evidence exists, such as Git commits, releases, or tagged files.

risk.description: Risk and ambiguity information. This section prevents overclaiming and clarifies that the trace record is evidence, not a final judgment.

origin_claim_strength.description: The strength of the origin-related claim represented by this trace record.

ambiguity_level.description: The level of ambiguity surrounding the trace relationship.

overclaim_risk.description: Risk that this record may be misread as legal proof, ownership enforcement, or automatic royalty entitlement.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes explaining uncertainty, limitations, or review needs.

status.description: The lifecycle status of this trace record.

supersedes.description: Optional trace_id of a previous trace record superseded by this one.

license.description: Optional license or usage note for the trace record itself.
